# DSH 1024Store

> The community plugin store, marketplace and hub for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), DeepSeek's coding-agent CLI where nearly everything is a plugin. 2,900+ plugins indexed across 11 categories, with GitHub-star rankings, anonymous install counts, and a free public search API.

Install any listed plugin with the official DeepSeek Harness CLI:

    dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/<repository>

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## Catalog

- [Plugin catalog](https://deepseek1024.com/plugins): every indexed DeepSeek Harness plugin, filterable by category
- [Plugin rankings](https://deepseek1024.com/): ranked by 24h star growth, GitHub stars, releases and repository activity
- [Full plugin list with descriptions and install commands](https://deepseek1024.com/llms-full.txt): the whole catalog as plain text

## API

- [API reference](https://deepseek1024.com/docs/api): rate limits, error codes, and GitHub-login API keys
- Public search endpoint, free and no key required for light use, called directly rather than crawled:
  `GET https://api.deepseek1024.com/v1/plugins/search?q=theme`

## Source

- [Site and CLI source](https://github.com/imsai-sh/dsh1024-oss): the deepseek1024.com Worker and the dsh1024 npm package
- [Catalog repository](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins): the awesome list and plugin submissions
- [Submit a plugin](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [DeepSeek Harness itself](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)
